name: poor
quote: I can't afford to go out tonight.
description: A sense that you lack a valued physical, social, or mental asset that many others have.

variations.name: caused to be poor
variations.description: A sense that someone is blocking you from having more of a valued asset than many others.

variations.name: fixably poor
variations.description: A sense that you have less of a valued asset than many others, but can work your way to having more.

variations.name: envious poor
variations.description: A sense of desire to have as much of a valued asset as others.

variations.name: poor shame
variations.description: If lacking the asset makes you feel bad about yourself, you may feel shame.

variations.name: my fault poor
variations.description: If you perceive that your own actions led to having less of the asset, you may feel regret or humility.
examples: I shouldn't have gone to the casino.

variations.name: gracefully poor
variations.description: A sense of gratitude even when having less of an asset valued by many others.

commentaries.quote: People need all different kinds of stuff. We keep track of who has how much of each kind, and this bookkeeping causes all sorts of emotions: from admiration and inspiration to envy and anger.
We are all poor in something. It may help to know where your assets are unbalanced.

conditions: A sense that you have less of a valued asset than many others.
